verdict.rationale: Anrok's API saves each transaction and associates it with the appropriate tax return, voids remove transactions from returns, and a filings endpoint lets you fetch filings programmatically. Marketing shows dashboards with sales data and tax obligations by jurisdiction, and an AI assistant grounded in transactions and filings. Together these give filing-oriented, per-jurisdiction visibility, but there is no evidence of a real-time accrued-liability view or of accountant- or GL-ready exports. Missing for 10: an explicit collected-versus-owed accrued liability report by jurisdiction, documented CSV/accountant exports, GL/ERP journal export or sync, detailed filing-ready report docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
